source.date_note: Article 54 general application: 20 January 2027, with separate article-specific dates; supplied corrigendum item 10 reviewed.

requirements.title: Scope and applicability
requirements.project_requirement: Record product/use/safety role and hazard register; justify applicability and exclusions. Charter alone is insufficient.

requirements.title: Firmware and configuration identity
requirements.project_requirement: Distinguish source, image, installed firmware and configuration. Target readback, authorized/unauthorized configuration-change tests. A source manifest is not installed identity.
requirements.missing_evidence: Target identity readback and configuration-change tests
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Identify critical software/data and installed software needed for safe operation; provide accessible identity

requirements.title: Protection against corruption
requirements.project_requirement: Define protected assets and interfaces; test corrupt firmware/configuration, access paths and hardware faults on target. Signature verification covers only part of this requirement.
requirements.missing_evidence: Approved-key positive end-to-end update and physical corruption tests
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Protect relevant hardware, critical software and data against accidental/intentional corruption

requirements.title: Intervention evidence
requirements.project_requirement: Record real target events, including approved changes and rejected attempts, with attributable identity/context and durable retrieval. A signed envelope is not an event store.
requirements.missing_evidence: Persistent intervention recording connected to actual target events
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Collect evidence of legitimate/illegitimate software interventions or software/configuration modifications

requirements.title: Control faults and malicious attempts
requirements.project_requirement: Machine-specific safe response to hostile peers, reset, partitions and sensor faults; hardware tests and hazard-linked acceptance limits. Fail-closed must be defined physically, not equated automatically with removing power.
requirements.missing_evidence: Machine hazard analysis, partition/split-brain and physical fault tests
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Prevent hazardous effects of stresses, external influences, foreseeable malicious attempts, hardware/logic faults and foreseeable human errors

requirements.title: Retention and retrieval
requirements.project_requirement: Define per-upload retention, export and storage responsibility; measure capacity, wear, clock/epoch, exhaustion, recovery and retrieval. Do not relabel this as five years for every telemetry sample.
requirements.missing_evidence: Five-year post-upload tracing-log retention/retrieval design and deployed tests; not all telemetry
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Enable tracing log of intervention data and safety-software versions uploaded after market/service, for five years after upload, for the stated conformity purpose and authority-request conditions

requirements.title: Risk assessment and verification
requirements.project_requirement: Link hazards to functions, controls, residual risks and evidence; adversarial software review is not a machine hazard analysis.
requirements.missing_evidence: Machine-specific hazard register and requirement/evidence closure
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Risk assessment and risk reduction over intended use and foreseeable misuse

requirements.title: Integration and release claims
requirements.project_requirement: Keep host, target-build and physical evidence distinct; no claim closure without applicability and accepted evidence.
requirements.missing_evidence: Complete applicable evidence and human adjudication
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Evidence/claim discipline; project assurance rule, not a verbatim statutory obligation

requirements.title: Connecting another device or communicating remote device must not create a hazardous situation
requirements.missing_evidence: Applicable design, integration and accepted validation evidence
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Connecting another device or communicating remote device must not create a hazardous situation
requirements.project_requirement: Node admission/disagreement/partition contracts plus fault injection; measure the actuator outcome. More nodes can add attack and fault paths.

requirements.title: Collect legitimate/illegitimate intervention evidence for relevant hardware components
requirements.missing_evidence: Applicable design, integration and accepted validation evidence
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Collect legitimate/illegitimate intervention evidence for relevant hardware components
requirements.project_requirement: Enumerate debug, boot, communication and access hardware within scope; implement and test relevant intervention detection and recording. The earlier software-only evidence row omitted this surface.

requirements.title: Conditional: bound task/movement space and maintain ability to correct for inherent safety
requirements.missing_evidence: Applicable design, integration and accepted validation evidence
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Conditional: bound task/movement space and maintain ability to correct for inherent safety
requirements.project_requirement: Classify actual evolving/autonomous behaviour. If applicable, demonstrate deterministic limits and correction under faults. No automatic exemption from an advisory label.

requirements.title: Conditional: enable recording of safety decision data and retain for one year after collection, with stated purpose/request conditions
requirements.missing_evidence: Applicable design, integration and accepted validation evidence
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Conditional: enable recording of safety decision data and retain for one year after collection, with stated purpose/request conditions
requirements.project_requirement: Separate this retention class from EU-M17-006; define covered decisions, persistent recording and retrieval tests. Do not apply automatically to every AI output.

requirements.title: Prevent unsafe restart, uncontrolled parameters and hazardous rule changes; preserve stopping/protection and coherent assembly safety
requirements.missing_evidence: Applicable design, integration and accepted validation evidence
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Prevent unsafe restart, uncontrolled parameters and hazardous rule changes; preserve stopping/protection and coherent assembly safety
requirements.project_requirement: Test restart authorization, update/recovery, stop priority and assembly-level consistency. This includes physical control behaviour beyond host quorum logic.

requirements.title: Wireless-control communication/connection failure must not create a hazardous situation
requirements.missing_evidence: Applicable design, integration and accepted validation evidence
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Wireless-control communication/connection failure must not create a hazardous situation
requirements.project_requirement: Conditional on wireless control. Define link fault response and test; transport is not selected merely by a NodeLink abstraction.

requirements.title: Relevant high-risk AI requirements, delegated acts and standards framework
requirements.missing_evidence: Applicable design, integration and accepted validation evidence
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Relevant high-risk AI requirements, delegated acts and standards framework
requirements.project_requirement: Create AI use/safety classification and source-monitoring decision. Review AI Act text and applicable instruments before approving a claim. No AI regulatory closure in this review.

requirements.title: Manufacturer technical documentation and conformity responsibilities
requirements.missing_evidence: Applicable design, integration and accepted validation evidence
requirements.candidate_source_clause: Articles 10–11 and Annex IV, subject to product classification
requirements.source_obligation_summary: Manufacturer technical documentation and conformity responsibilities
requirements.project_requirement: Expand beyond firmware clauses into the applicable technical file, integration information and assessment route. A signed release is supply-chain evidence, not conformity assessment.

applicability_decision_inputs: product classification and digital safety role
